req.title: Health probe returns liveness
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /health/ with HTTP 200 and a status:'ok' JSON body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /health/ returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing status:'ok'. To achieve high mutation kill rate: (1) positive EP test asserts exact status code 200 and exact JSON body {'status':'ok'} — catches constant mutations on status code and string mutations on the key/value; (2) negative NEG test verifies that an unsupported method (POST) on /health/ returns 405, not 200 — catches mutations that flip the 200 constant or remove method guards; (3) boundary BVA test asserts the Content-Type header is application/json and that the response body contains exactly the key 'status' with exactly the value 'ok' (no extra keys, no wrong values) — catches mutations that alter the response body structure or content-type. Together these cover the two sides of the status-code comparison, the exact string constant 'ok', and the HTTP method boundary.

tests.name: test_health_get_returns_200_and_status_ok
preconditions: FastAPI app is importable from main
health_route is registered on the app
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the FastAPI app
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_health_get_returns_200_and_status_ok():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/health/')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.json()
    assert body == {'status': 'ok'}
    assert body['status'] == 'ok'
    assert len(body) == 1

test_health_get_returns_200_and_status_ok()

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_health_response_content_type_and_exact_body_structure():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/health/')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in response.headers.get('content-type', '')
    body = response.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert list(body.keys()) == ['status']
    assert body['status'] == 'ok'
    assert body['status'] != 'OK'
    assert body['status'] != 'Ok'
    assert body['status'] != True
    assert body['status'] != 1

test_health_response_content_type_and_exact_body_structure()
